evidence.title: Vapat Enters the data center market with a 160MW project in Valladolid

summary: Vapat is debuting in the data center sector with a new 160‑megawatt facility slated for Valladolid, Spain. The project aims to increase regional cloud capacity and signals the company’s expansion beyond its prior focus.
title: Vapat Launches 160MW Data Center Project in Valladolid, Marking Entry into the Market
